Subject: Greenline Health - Tenant activation & initial API provisioning

Hi Alex —

Great speaking with you earlier. As promised, here’s a concise activation plan to get Greenline’s first tenant live in our Hosted Dedicated environment. I’ve assigned owners on our side and called out blockers so we can keep the kickoff to a single week if your team is ready.

High-level steps (target: 7 business days):
- Provision tenant + project namespace (Redwood) — owner: Tessa
- Seed admin users + role matrix — owner: Monica
- Generate initial API keys and service account for ingestion pipeline — owner: Dev
- Confirm data residency and audit log hook — owner: Grace (CS)
- Procurement/SOW completed and signed — your side

Immediate asks for Greenline:
1) Please confirm list of 3 initial admin users (name + email + role).
2) Procurement point-of-contact for PO/SOW (we attached the signed SOW stub).
3) Any IP allowlist or VPC endpoints we should pre-configure?

Attachments: [Attachment: Tenant_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)] [Attachment: Greenline_SOW_signed.pdf (pdf)]

If you’re available, Monica and Dev can do a 30-min tech kickoff tomorrow to walk provisioning steps. Proposed time: 10:00–10:30 AM PT.

Thanks —

Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0121

Thanks, Tessa — this looks good and very actionable. Quick answers:
- Admin users (first 3): Me (alex.wu@greenlinehealth.com), Meera Shah (meera.shah@greenlinehealth.com), and Luis Ortega (luis.ortega@greenlinehealth.com). Roles: Alex = Org Admin, Meera = Security Admin, Luis = Platform Admin.
- Procurement contact: procurement@greenlinehealth.com (cc'd) — they handle PO and signatures.
- VPC: We will use their managed connectivity; please hold off on allowlists until we confirm the endpoint IPs.

10:00 AM PT tomorrow works for the tech kickoff. Can Monica + Dev send a calendar invite?

Alex / team —

Perfect, thanks for the list. I’ll take the admin seed after the kickoff. For transparency, here’s what I’ll configure during the seed:
- Create tenant: greenline-prod-redwood
- Create project namespaces: ingestion, api-prod, evaluation
- Seed admin users (Org Admin, Security Admin, Platform Admin)
- Roles and policies: admin, billing-view, deployer, security-audit
- MFA and SSO hints: do you plan to use SAML SSO? If so, send IdP metadata prior to the handoff.

Action items for tomorrow’s 10:00 AM PT call:
- Dev: will demo API key generation & service-account creation
- Tessa: will confirm rollout windows and owners
- Alex: confirm SSO plan and any IP/VPC constraints

Attaching a trimmed checklist for the seed operation.

Monica

On Apr 18, 2027, at 10:01 AM, Alex Wu <alex.wu@greenlinehealth.com> wrote:
> 10:00 AM PT tomorrow works for the tech kickoff. Can Monica + Dev send a calendar invite?

I sent a calendar invite for 2027-04-19 10:00–10:30 AM PT (accepted by Alex). Agenda: quick tenant provisioning demo (10 min), API key/service account walkthrough (10 min), Q&A + next steps (10 min).

Pre-kickoff checklist for Greenline engineers (small ask):
- Confirm if service account should be restricted by egress IPs (yes/no)
- Provide preferred key rotation cadence (we default to 90 days)
- If using SAML SSO, share metadata URL or XML before provisioning

I’ll prepare a short script to auto-seed the project namespace and create one long-lived service account key for ingestion. We recommend creating short-lived runtime keys and a CI-based rotation in week 2.

- Dev
Senior Software Engineer, Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Greenline Health - Tenant activation & initial API provisioning - Post-kickoff notes

Thanks for the productive demo, everyone. Summary and agreed owners:
- Tenant and project namespaces provisioned: greenline-prod-redwood (Monica)
- Admin users seeded (Monica)
- Initial API key and service account created (Dev) — key delivered to Alex via secure vault link
- SSO: Greenline to send IdP metadata to grace.oconnor@redwood.ai by EOD Monday
- Procurement: procurement@greenlinehealth.com to confirm PO number and billing contact (cc'd)

Open/blockers:
- IP allowlist: pending final endpoint IPs from Greenline network team (Alex)
- Key rotation policy: Greenline to confirm if 90-day rotation is acceptable or if they want weekly short-lived tokens for ingestion pipelines.

Next steps (owners & ETA):
- Greenline: provide IdP metadata + endpoint IPs (Alex) — ETA: 2027-04-26
- Procurement: provide PO number (procurement@greenlinehealth.com) — ETA: 2027-04-22
- Redwood: finalize audit log delivery and S3 bucket retention policy (Grace) — ETA: 2027-04-23

I’ve uploaded the finalized checklist and the signed SOW to our Drive: https://redwood.app/drive/Greenline-Onboard-Plan. If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll pick up immediately.

Tessa Morgan
